messages:
ana: heads-up: onboarding a narrowed-quant magnet-13B-int4 variant with a 10k anchored prefix. seeing a tiny, reproducible mismatch in token probabilities only when rope_scale != 1.0 and prefill is streamed across multiple KV shards.

li: quick question: is it a bit-flip or a drifting logit scenario?

ana: drifting logits. model stays stable until ~token 6123 then top-3 changes persist afterwards across seeds.

mike: can you attach a short trace + the pack metadata for the shard boundary where the stream flips?

ana: pushed artifacts: /mnt/ci/artifacts/4345002222/{trace.seed42.log,kv_meta.page248.json,rot_vector.page248.bin}. Also added a tiny test:
```bash
./test_harness --model magnet-13B-int4-narrow --rope-scale 1.12 --prefill-file fixtures/long_anchor_10k.txt --stream-prefill true --seed 42
```
Output: "token_diverge step=6124 expected=\"from\" got=\"for\""

sophia: did you try disabling packing (store unpacked) or forcing host-side rot multipliers?

ana: yes: unpacked pages -> PASS; host-rot fp32 -> PASS. So packing + quant path implicated.

mike: plausible root cause: when nibble-packed KV pages cross the page boundary we sometimes shift the byte alignment temporarily in the write routine, altering the quantization rounding for rot multipliers. small multiplier delta -> phase shift -> top-k flip later.

li: proposal: short mitigation in runtime: ensure rot multipliers are kept at FP32 for any prefill > 2k OR add a pad byte when pack would cross page boundary. perf tradeoffs documented.

dev-bot: CI: 4345002222-int4-longprefill run completed: 1 failing test. artifacts available.

ana: filing INF-rot-pack-align with repro and artifacts. PR incoming with a pad-fix + unit test that fuzzes alignments. I'll also add an Optimize modelprofile flag: prefill_rot_host_fp=true.

sophia: add a regression eval: run 5 seeds of our long-context golden and assert embedding cosine > 0.9999 up to 9.5k tokens. if pack-change regresses perf we'll revert to host-rot fallback.

mike: thanks. if anyone wants to bisect the kernel pack code ping me and I can take the low-level diff.

ana: will follow up with PR and tracker issue id. thanks all!
